text:
Hi there,

I'm thinking of renting out the Castellan Imperial for a corporate event - it's been a while since I've gotten to drive something like that, reminds me of the time I rented a similar car for my sister's wedding. We would pick it up on Sun 25 Apr 2027 at 08:30 and bring it back on Tue 27 Apr 2027 at 10 am. I just wanted to clarify that the pick-up date is indeed Sun 9 May 2027, not the initial drop-off date. Also, could you bring it to the Old Customs House, Port Linden and collect it from there afterwards? I've included a copy of my driving licence as requested.

Best wishes,
Ada Dunsmere
